name: twinned spell
desc: When you cast a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, you can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

To be eligible, a spell must be incapable of targeting more than one creature at the spell's current level. For example, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.41JIhpDyM9Anm7cs]{Magic Missile} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.7u2obDvuvtZBkTfq]{Scorching Ray} aren't eligible, but @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.ctW81uiX56xZR2c5]{Ray of Frost} is.
